messages.Optional and off by default. Only accoun: Optional and off by default. Only accounts that also opt in inside the app are counted. Completed UTC-day iOS/Android totals go to your telemetry hub only for cohorts of at least five accounts. No names, account IDs, content, site URLs or GPS location are included. Country comes from site settings. General usage sharing must also be on. Sign-in and app features do not depend on this choice.
messages.Appearance of the desktop and mobile app: Appearance of the desktop and mobile app. Empty colours come from the theme (theme.json) and the Flux Admin colour. Menus are filtered by the user's role: an item they cannot see in the admin does not show in the app either.
